benches.name: kit_post_stg_r1
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_wfc_ep_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_wfc_ep_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { python3 tools/dsrom_wfc_kit_bench.py --out {RUN}/kitbench --case post_stg_r1
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the 4550cfabc snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_wfc_ep_m5/src]
